source.endpoint: dashboard Advisor page (Security Advisor) for project hhqgreaoqulmfwfwarhc; response of the page's own run-lints call
source.operation: read-only; GET-only linter run triggered by the page Refresh control; no SQL, DDL or DML issued
source.note: Extract, not the full payload: verbatim detail prose lives in the project's advisor data and is reproducible with Refresh. Every finding is listed; strings are parsed into object identifiers.

findings.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
findings.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
findings.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.
findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

findings.name: auth_rls_initplan
findings.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
findings.description: Detects if calls to current_setting() and auth.<function>() in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
findings.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
findings.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.name: unindexed_foreign_keys
findings.title: Unindexed foreign keys
findings.description: Identifies foreign key constraints without a covering index, which can impact database performance.

findings.name: unused_index
findings.title: Unused Index
findings.description: Detects if an index has never been used and may be a candidate for removal.
